admitted_scope: Ribasim is sole accepted owner of the represented secondary surface-water storage and level.
SWAP5 receives a typed accepted external surface-water head for exactly one EXTENDED_SIGNED drainage-response level.
Positive soil-to-surface-water drainage and negative surface-water-to-soil infiltration are supported.
Realized-transfer mismatch prevents commit and triggers same-origin discard/recomposition.
Availability-limited infiltration is resolved using live Ribasim receipt semantics; accept-with-clip is forbidden.
Exactly one SWAP accepted outer substep and exactly one final commit occur per accepted coupling window.
RIBASIM_NATIVE_GEOMETRY_V1 is the default production geometry contract for this profile.
explicit_exclusions: full SWAP5 + MODFLOW6 + Ribasim triangle admission

migration_options.legacy_sttab_emulation: Q1H epsilon-controlled representation remains a separately named migration/emulation option and is not the default production geometry.
